title: Differentials of a smooth morphism are free near a point, of rank the fibre dimension
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a smooth morphism of schemes [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], $x\in X$, $s=f(x)$ with residue field $\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-residue-field], $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ the fibre of $f$ over $s$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] and $x'\in X_s$ the point of $X_s$ lying over $x$. Then $d:=\dim_{x'}(X_s)$ [def-kun-dimension] is a non-negative integer, and there are affine open subschemes $V\subseteq S$ and $W\subseteq X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] with $x\in W$ and $f(W)\subseteq V$ such that, with $R=\mathcal O_S(V)$, $A=\mathcal O_X(W)$ and $R\to A$ the ring map corresponding to $f|_W:W\to V$, the module of Kähler differentials $\Omega_{A/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is a free $A$-module of rank $d$.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 02G1 (label lemma-smooth-omega-finite-locally-free, line 7214: for f smooth, Omega_{X/S} is finite locally free with rank_x(Omega_{X/S}) = dim_x(X_{f(x)})), read on an affine open W = Spec A over V = Spec R where Omega_{X/S}|_W is the sheaf of Omega_{A/R} (Lemma 01UT, label lemma-differentials-affine, line 6441) and shrunk to a principal open on which this finite locally free module is free; smoothness in the sense of [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] is that of Morphisms Definition 01V5 by more-morphisms.tex Lemma 02H6 (lemma-smooth-formally-smooth)

proof.text: Use Mathlib Smooth.exists_isStandardSmooth (lem-weil-pbc-smooth-locally-standard-smooth) to choose affine V in S and W in X containing x, with W ≤ f preimage V and the induced algebra standard smooth. Extract a finite submersive presentation P and put d = P.dimension. The presentation gives IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension d for the ring map. Transfer its local form across arrowResLEAppIso using HasRingHomProperty.iff_of_isAffine, obtaining SmoothOfRelativeDimension d for f.resLE V W. Compose with the open immersion V.ι, which adds relative dimension zero, to obtain SmoothOfRelativeDimension d for W.ι ≫ f.

Let O be the inverse image of W under f.fiberι (f x). The canonical point f.asFiber x lies in O because fiberι_asFiber gives its image x. Paste isPullback_morphismRestrict with the defining fibre square to see that O.ι ≫ f.fiberToSpecResidueField (f x) is the base change of W.ι ≫ f. Mathlib stability under base change gives SmoothOfRelativeDimension d for this morphism over the residue field. Apply the already proved source-library theorem AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Smooth at the point ⟨f.asFiber x,hxO⟩. Its local dimension is d. IsOpen.topologicalKrullDimAt_eq identifies this with the local dimension at f.asFiber x in the original fibre.

The same presentation P gives Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension d for Γ(X,W) over Γ(S,V). Apply the already proved Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.nonempty_linearEquiv_kaehlerDifferential from WeilConjectures.Mathlib.RingTheory.Smooth.StandardSmoothCotangent, which reindexes the basis of lem-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-kahler-basis by Fin d. Map Pi.basisFun along the inverse linear equivalence. CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential for f.appLE is definitionally the corresponding algebraic differential module. Return d, the dimension equality, and the chosen V,W,hWV,hx,hV,hW and basis.

split_report.summary: Statement kept (correct against Stacks 02G1 read on an affine open); stmt_deps kept. Proof follows the proof of Morphisms 02G1 exactly: locally f is standard smooth on affines (Morphisms 01V7, new node lem-weil-pbc-smooth-locally-standard-smooth, unsplit), Omega of a standard smooth presentation is free on dx_{c+1..n} (Algebra 00T7(2), new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-kahler-basis = SubmersivePresentation.basisKaehler), the fibre over s near x' is Spec of the fibre ring A⊗_R κ(p) (written out from existing leaves: open-fibre-product, fibre-product-affine-spectra, spec-residue-field-identification, morphism-from-spec-field, dimension-at-point-open-subspace), the fibre ring is standard smooth over κ(p) with the same n, c (Algebra 00T7(5), new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-base-change = SubmersivePresentation.baseChange) and a standard smooth algebra over a field has dimension n−c at every point (Algebra 00T7(7) + remark after 00S9 + 00OT, new node lem-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-over-field-dimension-at-points, unsplit). New definition def-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-algebra (Stacks 00T6, Mathlib leaf Algebra.IsStandardSmooth). The route suggested in the brief (Omega finite projective, 00NX, rank = fibre dimension via 00TT) was not taken: it is not the proof of the source, and 00TT (1)⇒(3) is itself proved in Stacks through standard smooth algebras.
